```{r eval=TRUE, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE}
# Cargar la librería si no está cargada
library(fontawesome)
library(htmltools) # Útil para construir el enlace completo
library(DT)
# Definir los iconos y enlaces
rscience_icon <- tags$img(src = "images/Rscience_logo_01.png", style = "height: 1.5em;")
github_icon   <- fa("github", fill = "#333333", height = "1.5em")
linkedin_icon <- fa("linkedin", fill = "#0077B5", height = "1.5em")
youtube_icon  <- fa("youtube", fill = "#FF0000", height = "1.5em") # Rojo de YouTube

# Construir los enlaces completos
rscience_link <- tags$a(
  href = "*https://google.com/",
  target = "_blank",
  style = "margin-right: 30px; text-decoration: none; color: #333;",
 rscience_icon#, " GitHub"
)

# Construir los enlaces completos
github_link <- tags$a(
  href = "*https://github.com/",
  target = "_blank",
  style = "margin-right: 30px; text-decoration: none; color: #333;",
  github_icon#, " GitHub"
)

linkedin_link <- tags$a(
  href = "https://www.linkedin.com/in/deliaspanigo/",
  target = "_blank",
  style = "margin-right: 30px; text-decoration: none; color: #0077B5;",
  linkedin_icon#, " LinkedIn"
)

# NUEVO: Enlace de YouTube
youtube_link <- tags$a(
  # **¡IMPORTANTE! Sustituye esta URL por la de tu canal de YouTube**
  href = "[https://www.youtube.com/user/TuCanal](https://www.youtube.com/)", 
  target = "_blank",
  style = "margin-right: 30px; text-decoration: none; color: #FF0000;",
  youtube_icon
)


# Mostrar los elementos HTML generados
div(
  # **Cambiado:** Usamos display: flex y gap para espaciado uniforme
  style = "font-size: 1.5em; margin-top: 20px; display: flex; gap: 30px;", 
  rscience_link,
  github_link,
  linkedin_link,
  youtube_link
)
```
